title: BXT Gravel Frame Review

takeaways.text: A size-56 Gravel 135 frameset in custom Blue Iris paint cost him about US$440 with tax plus US$40 UPS shipping to California in mid-2024; headset, axles and seat clamp were included, seatpost and bars were not.

He saw small voids where the inside of the seat tube was machined (covered by the seatpost) and one paint chip; the aluminium bottom-bracket insert, threads and dropouts looked cleanly machined and the label lists a 100 kg rider limit.
On a hanging scale the painted size-56 frame weighed about 1,330 g and the fork about 500 g with its hardware.

disclosure: The presenter bought the frameset from BXT's official AliExpress store with his own money; no sponsorship is stated.
summary: Owner unboxing and weigh-in of a size-56 BXT Gravel 135 frameset; this is the frame of the candidate's complete build, not the GRX complete bike itself.
